THE FALLS
Central Park · mockup

The Falls

Where the brook leaves the big lake, the park drops off an 18 m rock shelf. The brook pours over it into a deep green pool, then runs on down to the pond. Built on Polyfork's rocks, ledges, basalt, moss, ferns and logs.

Light
Stand at
What's here, what you do
  • The falls. Three sheets of water, glassy at the lip, white lower down, with ragged edges and side trickles over the ledges. Spray, rolling mist and a rainbow in the morning sun. look · sound · photos
  • The plunge pool. Deep green over the drop, clear and pebbly at the front: churning foam under the falls, ripples, trout, lily pads on the calm side, coins glinting on the bed. swim · dive · fish · toss a coin
  • The jump rock. A ledge 12 m up the right side, over the deepest water. cliff jump
  • The mossy stairs. Polyfork's stone steps up the left shoulder, stone lanterns lit from dusk. climb to the top
  • The lip. The brook racing over the edge, a rope bridge across it, cairns. lookout · build a cairn
  • The rope swing. On an old tree at the pool's right shore. swing and drop in
  • Down the brook. Stepping stones, mossy and fungus logs, reeds and cattails, frogs on the lilies. wade · forage · park finds
  • Night. Glowing mushrooms in the rocks, fireflies, bats over the pool, the lanterns, the falls under the moon. night walk
